notes: Apply only after the named checks appear on a pull request with: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/main/protection -X PUT --input .github/branch-protection.json
Requires repository administration and should be reviewed as a change-control operation.
The protected production environment in .github/workflows/production-promotion.yml adds a separate manual approval after staging device/KMS and OBS-001 gates pass.
No mutable image tag, host-side image build, unreviewed migration, or unapproved production environment deployment is accepted by the promotion workflow.
